title: DoomNotes summarization output
description: This file is the single source of truth for what the model must return. It is passed verbatim to Ollama's `format` parameter, which compiles it to a llama.cpp grammar — so conformance is a constraint on generation, not a request in the prompt. Tightening a constraint here changes what the model is physically able to emit. Fields NOT listed here (source_url, platform, author, posted_at, saved_at, source_order, processed_at) are never model-generated: they come from the ref and from yt-dlp metadata, because a model asked for a URL will invent one.

title.description: A human-readable title in sentence case describing what the video is ABOUT, as a person would say it aloud. Not a filename, not hyphenated, not a slug, and not a description of the post itself. Good: 'Postgres partial indexes for soft-deleted rows'. Bad: 'creator-instagram-database-api-caption', 'Instagram caption offers setup link'.

summary.description: 2-3 sentences on what the video actually claims or teaches.

key_points.description: Concrete, checkable points. Not a restatement of the summary.

links.description: Links, products, tools, books or named resources mentioned. Empty array if none — never invent one.

topic.description: Single primary topic. Reuse an existing registry tag when one fits.

tags.description: Up to 5 tags. Prefer existing registry tags; mint a new one only when nothing fits.

has_speech.description: Whether the source material contained actual spoken or written content to summarize, as opposed to the model working from a caption alone.
